name: Vscodium-web
description: Vscodium-web is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of the remote host web component of Microsoft's editor VS Code.
short_desc: Vscodium-web is a community-driven, freely-licensed binary distribution of the remote host web component of Microsoft's
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: CONNECTION_TOKEN
form_fields.hint: Optional security token for accessing the Web UI (ie. supersecrettoken).

form_fields.label: CONNECTION_TOKEN_FILE
form_fields.hint: Optional path to a file inside the container that contains the security token for accessing the Web UI (ie. /path/to/file). Overrides CONNECTIONTOKEN.

form_fields.label: SUDO_PASSWORD
form_fields.hint: If this optional variable is set, user will have sudo access in the vscodium-web terminal with the specified password.

form_fields.label: SUDO_PASSWORD_HASH
form_fields.hint: Optionally set sudo password via hash (takes priority over SUDOPASSWORD var). Format is $type$salt$hashed.

form_fields.label: CODE_ARGS
form_fields.hint: Optionally add cli parameters to vscodium binary.
